title: Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment
content:
SOP: Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment (SOP-DIE-001)
DEPARTMENT: Facility Management
VERSION: 1.6
ROLES: dietitian, pantry_staff
PURPOSE: Standardize diabetic, renal, low-salt, and enteral nutrition trays.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment in full compliance with Facility Management hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Facility Management.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-DIE-001 Therapeutic and Inpatient Dietary Fulfillment v1.6, Section 4
